title: Deliverect stores
subtitle: Stores onboarded on a Deliverect account, and whether Deliverect has linked them yet.

access.deniedHint: Your account does not hold the Deliverect stores grant. Ask an administrator if you need it.
access.unreachableHint: Your access could not be checked, so this screen stays closed. Try again in a moment.

results.failedTitle: The stores could not be loaded

account.fallbackHint: The account list is not available to you. Type the account key; a wrong key is refused.

onboard.title: Onboard a store on Deliverect
onboard.note: The store is onboarded now and reads Onboarded, not linked until Deliverect registers it.
onboard.warningTitle: Store <store>{{store}}</store> is onboarded — it is on the direct HungerStation rail
onboard.warningHint: HungerStation orders stay on the direct rail for this store; every other delivery platform comes through Deliverect.

move.title: Move a store to another Deliverect account
move.note: Store <store>{{store}}</store> moves from <from>{{from}}</from>. Its link to Deliverect is cleared: it reads Onboarded, not linked until Deliverect registers it again on the new account.
move.doneDetail: Store {{store}} is on {{account}}, not linked yet.

remove.title: Remove a store's onboarding
remove.note: Store <store>{{store}}</store> leaves Deliverect: its stock sync stops and its link to Deliverect is cleared. Its history stays.
remove.doneDetail: Store {{store}} is no longer on Deliverect.

syncHealth.deltaOverdue_one: No run in the last {{minutes}} minute.
syncHealth.deltaOverdue_other: No run in the last {{minutes}} minutes.

pause.title: Pause the stock sync
pause.note: Store <store>{{store}}</store> stops sending its stock to Deliverect. Pausing stops the stock pushes only: the store stays listed on every delivery platform and it can still receive orders.
pause.doneDetail: Store {{store}} no longer pushes its stock. It still receives orders.

resume.title: Resume the stock sync
resume.note: Store <store>{{store}}</store> starts sending its stock to Deliverect again on the next run.
resume.doneDetail: Store {{store}} pushes its stock again from the next run.

logs.hint: The most recent runs first, at most {{max}}.
logs.failed: The sync log could not be loaded
logs.empty: No stock sync has run for this store yet.

statusAction.title: Set the store status

notes.none: Choose what Deliverect is told about store <store>{{store}}</store>.
notes.busy: Deliverect marks store <store>{{store}}</store> busy on every delivery platform, with the preparation delay below.
notes.close: Deliverect closes store <store>{{store}}</store> on every delivery platform until it is reopened.
notes.reopen: Deliverect reopens store <store>{{store}}</store> on every delivery platform.

statusAction.delayInvalid: Enter a whole number of minutes, more than 0.
statusAction.notLinked: Deliverect has not linked this store yet, so nothing can be sent for it.
statusAction.deliverectFailed: Deliverect did not accept it. Its answer:

hours.title: Push the opening hours now
hours.note: The opening hours of store <store>{{store}}</store> are read from the duty roster and sent to Deliverect now.
hours.empty: No hours were sent for this store.
hours.doneDetail: The opening hours of store {{store}} reached Deliverect.

history.hint: At most the {{max}} most recent changes.
history.failed: The status history could not be loaded
history.empty: No status change has been sent for this store yet.

reason.label: Reason
reason.hint: Required. It is kept with the change.
